scope: Bounded independent Apple-produced 512-slide repeated-layout Keynote read/project and complete editable PowerPoint conversion/save; opt-in runtime observations.

host.contention: Unrelated concurrent Swift builds observed. No idle-host claim or portable budgets.
host.measurementRuntime: .NET 9.0.10 via PowerShell 7.5.4 loading net8.0 workload assemblies

runner.policy: One warmup per operation, three measured iterations per operation, rotated order, collection before each iteration, no outlier removal. Two fresh standard hosts plus a separate 10ms memory-sampling host.

measurementBoundary.LoadProject: Open immutable input bytes as an iWork source and read the selected Keynote semantic projection.
measurementBoundary.ConvertSave: Open the source, require complete editable reconstruction, create and save the PowerPoint destination through normal owners.
measurementBoundary.excluded: Native fixture creation, file reads/input hashing, model preparation, complete semantic/schema validation, result release and collected-heap probes.
measurementBoundary.memory: Allocated bytes include host invocation. Post-release collected deltas include validation/cache/host effects. Sampled managed/resident maxima are process-wide observed lower bounds, include sampler effects, and do not attribute native allocations.

validation.source: Exact slide count, ordered native identity digest, text, notes, visible status, RGB backgrounds, complete drawable inventory, frame position/size and zero rotation.
validation.savedPptx: All slide text, notes, visible status, RGB backgrounds, exact shape inventory, frame position/size, zero rotation/no flips, and Open XML validation.
validation.independentSourceAndAppleExports: All 512 selected native slide/text/note/frame records and Apple PPTX slides; complete pypdf text and canvas on all 512 Apple PDF pages. Selected source records initialized; auxiliary/opaque records inventoried only.

independentOfficeimoPptx.checks: Every slide text, notes, background, frame geometry, canvas and visible status; no native rendering or appearance claim.

validation.representativeAppearance: Six Cairo-rendered Apple PDF pages inspected: 1, 2, 255, 256, 511, 512. No native destination PPTX appearance claim.

metadata.benchmark.Contract: Deterministic synthetic ZIP, pinned Apple fixture, or OfficeIMO-created native Keynote package: load/project, load/convert/save, or native encoding/save. I/O cancellation requests follow package-read or native-copy I/O. Opt-in phase cancellation uses a preloaded source projection or native encoding before caller writes, with timed requests and active process CPU observations. Input/model preparation and full semantic recovery are outside timing. Owned native creation is not independent Apple or appearance qualification.
metadata.benchmark.PhaseCancellation: 25 ms timer after entering the operation harness; require at least 20 ms elapsed and 5 ms process CPU advancement before request, untouched caller output and complete source recovery. CPU includes observer/host work and scheduling does not locate an internal parser/encoder checkpoint. Timer-dependent cases are opt-in and are not ordinary correctness gates.
metadata.benchmark.NativeNumbersPolicy: Pinned simple.numbers requires editable output and all nine typed cells. Explicit partial policy accepts only IWORK_NUMBERS_CELL_PADDING_OMITTED and its partial-policy marker; automatic-decimal and border-width approximations remain reported. Unresolved selected units, references, declarations or cells, and other loss diagnostics fail validation.
metadata.benchmark.NativeLarge: Apple Keynote 15.4 saved 512 slides by repeating two native layouts. Full ordered source identities, text, notes, geometry and backgrounds are checked; all saved PPTX slides and schema are verified outside timing. Two repeated layouts do not qualify varied large presentations or complete appearance.
metadata.benchmark.Measurement: PowerForge elapsed time and managed allocation including host invocation. Working-set deltas are not peak or retained memory. Saving uses normal owner APIs.
metadata.benchmark.RetainedMemory: Opt-in collected process-wide managed heap before execution and after validation/result release. Includes host/cache effects; excludes native and peak memory.
metadata.benchmark.SampledMemory: Opt-in PowerForge managed-heap/resident observations during operations. Maxima are observed lower bounds, include observer/host effects and do not isolate native allocations. Instrumented timing uses a separate run mode.
metadata.benchmark.AffinityPolicy: Inherited; macOS processor placement is unqualified. Keep competing work idle and record host power mode.

limits: One Apple Keynote 15.4 repeated two-layout profile; no diverse-object, large Pages/Numbers or full opaque-record coverage.
Uncontrolled scheduling and competing Swift work prevent idle-host/portable timing or memory budgets and performance-change claims.
PowerShell measurements execute on .NET9; .NET8/.NET10 command execution is separate correctness proof.
Observed resident/managed maxima are not exact peaks or attributed native retention; short collected baselines do not establish a leak-free long run.

Poppler bbox misplaces fi ligatures and Splash rendered selected later pages blank; Cairo renders the six inspected pages correctly. pypdf warns about two wrong-pointing objects; no PDF conformance claim.
No native appearance validation of the reconstructed512-slide PPTX, other runtimes/architectures, cancellation phases, sandbox/device or distribution qualification.
